resources.string: PeerDesk disconnects when you leave the app. Come back and connect again.
Disconnected because the app went to the background. Connect again to continue.
The display surface is not available. Close the app and open it again.
Left mouse button. Hold it and drag to select; the pointer is the arrow tip.
Mouse body. Drag it to move the pointer.
Shrink the mouse to a small icon
Small mouse. Tap to open the full mouse, or drag to move it.

Gestures: tap = left click, swipe = move the view, long-press then release = right click, long-press then drag = drag, two-finger tap = right click, two fingers = scroll, pinch = zoom. Tap the small on-screen mouse for a full mouse with left and right buttons.
Your Wi-Fi or router link is slow or dropping packets (%1$d ms to the router). Move closer to the router or switch to 5 GHz.
The problem is on the internet path, not your Wi-Fi. Waiting or switching networks may help.
The network is slow or lossy. The router could not be measured, so the cause is probably on the internet path.
